paragraphs.text: Know when your DeepSeek Harness tasks need you. Local alerts, quiet notifications, and a task inbox.
DeepCanary
A task inbox and local notifications for DeepSeek Harness.
简体中文 · Documentation · Changelog · Releases
DeepCanary groups task updates in **Pending**, **Snoozed**, and **Activity**. It reminds you when DS
H needs an answer or approval, keeps routine completions in Activity, and returns you to the corresp
er or approval, keeps routine completions in Activity, and returns you to the corresponding session.

## Use
| View | What you'll find |

| **Pending** | Questions, approvals, and task updates that need attention |
| **Snoozed** | Reminde

rs scheduled for later |
| **Activity** | Routine completions, context compaction, and tasks you sto

eduled for later |
| **Activity** | Routine completions, context compaction, and tasks you stopped |
Select a reminder to see its details. Use the DSH button to open the session and reply or approve th
ere. Choose **More actions → Acknowledge** to clear the reminder from Pending, or **Snooze** to sche
actions → Acknowledge** to clear the reminder from Pending, or **Snooze** to schedule it for later.
Drag the title bar to move the panel and drag any edge or corner to resize it. Drag the divider to a
djust the list width. The **Layout** menu lets you dock, expand, restore, or reset the panel. DeepCa
nary remembers the layout on this device. In narrow windows, the list keeps its scroll position when
you return from a reminder.
For keyboard control, choose move or resize from **Layout**. Use the arrow keys to adjust the panel,
hold Shift for larger steps, press Enter to confirm, or press Escape to cancel.
## Notifications
Open **Alert settings** from the inbox. Set the minimum alert level, quiet hours, and the hourly lim
it for C2 interruptions. C3 reminders can still appear during quiet hours and after the C2 limit is
2 interruptions. C3 reminders can still appear during quiet hours and after the C2 limit is reached.
| Level | Meaning |

| **C3** | DSH is waiting for an answer or approval before it can continue |
| **C2** | An error or

unusual task state needs checking |
| **C1** | A routine update is available in Activity |
In WebUI, allow notifications for your DSH site and leave a DSH tab open. In Windows, allow notifica
tions from your browser or DeepSeek Harness. The desktop app can receive notifications while minimiz
ed or hidden if it is still running.
Click a notification to return to the reminder and session. Respond to questions and approvals in DS
H to continue the task.
## Update or remove
To replace an earlier version on Windows Desktop, uninstall DeepCanary from **Plugins**, then add `d
sh-deepcanary@0.1.9-rc.1` in the same DSH app. Follow any restart prompts. To remove the plugin, sto
p after uninstalling.
For WebUI, stop the server and repeat the installation commands. Use the same DSH data directory and

## Security and privacy
DeepCanary saves reminder metadata in your DSH data directory and uses local rules to decide when to
notify you. Read about the files it saves and how notifications use them. Data and privacy.
Use the private reporting channel for vulnerabilities. Security policy.
